evidence: fixed format with max line length 80

purpose.domain_detail: Federal Employee Program (FEP) health insurance claims processing - routes claims through benefits administration, pricing, payment calculation, COB (Coordination of Benefits), and subscriber liability processing
purpose.summary: This is a large production COBOL batch program (FH02P0M3) that routes health insurance claims through benefits administration, pricing, payment calculation, coordination of benefits (COB), and subscriber liability processing. It also performs crossfoot logic and writes supporting history records. It is part of the FEP (Federal Employee Program) NewClaims system, derived from SYSTEM85 program FH02P5M2.

notable_features: 73 CALL statements to subprograms (FH02P3M1 through FH02P3MJ etc.)
Dynamic CALL to FX70P2M6 for century date conversion
Supporting history record writing (N1, H3, K1, L1 record types)
verdict.notes: File is 302KB / 6731 lines, truncated to first 16000 chars for analysis. The comment *VSCOBII85 strongly suggests VS COBOL II compiler targeting COBOL-85. The program has an extensive maintenance history log from 2002 through at least 2011, with many tracked trouble tickets (TT#) and CMRs, indicating a mature production insurance claims system. DB2 SQL is used for claims history storage (CMR387791 DB2 conversion noted). The FEP context refers to the Blue Cross Blue Shield Federal Employee Program.
